## Detailed Briefing

# Technical Brief: Computer Networks Presented in PDF Format

## Introduction
This brief outlines the concept of computer networks as defined in the computer science and telecommunications domains, and explains why a Portable Document Format (PDF) is an ideal medium for disseminating such technical information.

## Network Basics
A computer network is a group of communicating computers and peripheral devices—collectively called hosts—that exchange data using communication protocols. Networking hardware mediates these exchanges, enabling reliable data transmission across diverse systems.

## PDF as the Delivery Format
The PDF (ISO 32000) format, originating from Adobe’s 1993 PostScript-based specification, encapsulates fixed‑layout documents that render consistently across applications, hardware, and operating systems. Embedding the brief as a PDF preserves text formatting, diagrams, and any images in a self‑contained form, ensuring that the technical content remains accessible and unaltered on any device.
